# YEET
# https://yeet.grok.me

> Version 1.0.0

YEET is a 2D physics stress-reliever playground for the Timeline.
Slingshot worries, memes, slime, and glass. Modes: Soft, Zen, Chaos, Freeplay.
Play is local-first. Scores and settings stay in the browser.
Not a social network. Not a tracker.

Canonical URL: https://yeet.grok.me
Source: https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/yeet-grok-me
Reviewed: 2026-09-07
